rationale: Builds directly on the current best Bigram Rank 64 projection-tail script and pivots to a new idea category instead of another tail-only replay. Earlier search found that cheap gated tail MLP recurrence was the most promising recurrence variant on the pre-bigram path, so this transplants that idea onto the stronger Bigram64 baseline: reuse the last two block MLPs once more with shared weights and learned gates. The change adds almost no int8 payload, keeps shapes compile-stable, and spends a small amount of extra compute to sharpen hidden states before the final quantized projection path.
title: Tail MLP Recurrence On Bigram64 Tail
